Docs.summary: Creates an enumerator for the characters in the formatted range.
Docs.returns: An enumerator that reads the formatted range in index order.

remarks.para: This .NET member reads each UTF-16 code unit through CharAt, starting at index zero and continuing while the index is less than Length(). A surrogate pair is returned as two separate characters.
The behavior is defined by the character-enumerator generator.

Docs.summary: Gets the equality classification of the formatted range endpoints.
Docs.value: The classification computed for the formatted endpoints.

remarks.para: The result distinguishes endpoints equal before rounding, endpoints equal only after rounding, and endpoints that do not qualify for an equality fallback. Different formatting fields also produce the not-equal classification.
This property does not by itself identify the displayed form. For example, the Range identity fallback still displays a range for equal endpoints.
The equality check and fallback selection are separate steps in the ICU range-formatting implementation.
